watches.name: THE ARC - BURNT ORANGE
watches.description: Available to preorder now. Shipping from 1st December. Evolving from The Seeker, the watch that established Beaucroft’s signature design language, The Arc builds upon the elements that have become synonymous with the brand. The flowing case architecture inspired by Cambridge’s Bridge of Sighs, expressive fumé dials and elegant leaf hands remain at its core, while a series of thoughtful refinements enhance both form and function. Slightly larger in size and refined in execution, The Arc retains the distinctive character of its predecessor while offering an even more versatile and balanced presence on the wrist. Created in response to how owners wore The Seeker, The Arc has been designed to move effortlessly between everyday life and more formal occasions. Enhanced lume, 100 metres of water resistance and a hardened case coating provide greater confidence in daily wear, while four richly graduated dial colours showcase Beaucroft’s passion for colour, light and detail. Hand-assembled and regulated in the UK, The Arc represents the natural evolution of The Seeker; refined, capable and designed to be worn every day. Prices shown in local currency.

watches.name: SENATE RED LION
watches.description: Retired edition. In partnership with the University of Cambridge we are excited to introduce the Limited Red Lion Edition to the Senate range. The Red Lion is a watch that blends the gap between an elegant dress watch and an everyday casual sports watch with it’s classic styling and vibrant colour palette. The Red Lion is a point of pride and a symbol of sporting prowess for undergraduates and Alumni of Cambridge University, but also more nationally a symbol of British sporting achievement. The satin finished Cambridge Blue inspired colour of the dial and contrasting red and white details provides a bold and eye catching pop of colour on a minimal and refined dial that is designed for great legibility. At 40mm in diameter size, a compact lug-to-lug of 45mm and just 10mm thick it catches attention whilst being elegant, sleek and ideal for range of wrist sizes, and paired with a choice of premium Horween Leather straps or a fine stainless steel Milanese mesh bracelet. The Senate Red Lion is fully hand assembled in the UK, by our expert assembly team. As well as assembly our team regulate the Miyota 9039 movement within in each watch to a tolerance of +/- 10 seconds per day.

watches.name: Seeker British Sky - Special Edition
watches.description: Sold out - The British Sky Seeker - Special Edition - limited to 25 pieces. British design for us is understated, clean and legible with a touch of playfulness and personality. These endearing characteristics are captured in our new special edition. We all know Britain is not known for it’s blue skies! Usually a mix of blues, with the white/grey of patched clouds. This is what we capture with the dial: a steely sky blue gradient dial with a blend of blues and greys, a satin finish base layer and a sun-ray finished chapter ring. Complemented by rich royal blue hour/minutes hands and a spirited red second hand, all shaped in collaboration with the Alliance of British Watch and Clock Makers. You will be given the choice of strap after the pre-order, prior to delivery.

watches.name: REBEL RED - BWD SPECIAL
watches.description: Sold out limited edition This 50 piece limited edition watch was launched for British Watchmakers' Day 2026. For 2026, Beaucroft brings together some of the strongest elements of its recent launches to create the Rebel Red. Limited to 50 pieces, this bold new release blends sporty elegance, understated stealth and Beaucroft’s signature playful pops of colour. The Rebel Red features a sleek tungsten carbide carbon-coated black case and a deep red gradient dial which shifts beautifully in changing light. The rich gradient, sunburst finish and unique colour, give the dial real depth, while Beaucroft’s soft blue gloss second hand adds a flash of personality. A matching black rubber strap completes the look with a seamless, refined aesthetic. The Rebel features Nitron MC - an advanced, scratch resistant Tungsten Carbide Carbon hard coating technology developed in Cambridge UK. The watch is complemented by a matching, cut to fit black FKM rubber strap for a seamless aesthetic, provided in partnership with UK strap specialist Under The Cuff. Prices shown in local currency.

watches.name: SOLARIS GMT
watches.description: SOLD OUT. Please click Notify Me to join our waiting list for any pieces which become available. Shipping in September 2026. Beaucroft, in collaboration with Time+Tide, unveils a new limited edition - the Solaris GMT. Limited to 200 pieces worldwide, the watch continues Beaucroft’s exploration of jet-setting design, reinterpreted through the lens of the Time+Tide London Watch Discovery Studio retail team. The Solaris GMT features a highly expressive dial design built around the idea of the sun in motion. This is the first Time+Tide collaboration to be conceived and created in this way. The concept behind the Solaris GMT is rooted in a simple idea: “The Sun Never Sets on Time+Tide.” As Time+Tide expands globally, with studios now operating across London, Melbourne, and New York, there is always daylight somewhere in their network. The watch captures this continuous movement of time, sunshine and creativity. Prices shown in local currency.

watches.name: CONTOUR GMT - TROPICAL TEAL
watches.description: SOLD OUT. Returning soon! Check Notify Me to be the first to hear when the next batch is ready. The Contour GMT takes its design inspiration from the most arresting view in aviation: the Earth seen from 37,000 feet. Each edition in the GMT range is inspired by the landscapes that unfurl below a flight path. The launch colourway “Tropical Teal” captures the breathtaking moment the Caribbean Sea comes into view: a gradient teal dial with shifting depths and shimmering sun-ray finish. Like its inspiration, the Contour GMT rewards what Beaucroft calls “The Long Look”. The 39.5mm case draws DNA from across the Beaucroft collection: the flowing hand profiles of the Seeker, the robust sportiness of the Element all united in an elegant package for the well-travelled wrist. Assembled and regulated in the UK, the Contour GMT is powered by the Miyota 9075 and offers 100m water resistance. Prices shown in local currency.

watches.name: ELEMENT - TEMPER RED
watches.description: Available to preorder now. Shipping from January 2027. Temper Red features a sophisticated deep-red gradient dial with the richness and depth of a full-bodied wine. The dial’s character shifts beautifully under changing light, thanks to its sunburst finish, applied diamond-cut rhodium-plated hands, and applied indices, details that have become synonymous with Beaucroft’s refined design language. At 39.5mm in diameter, a lug-to-lug of 46.5mm and 11.6mm thick, the Element has presence whilst being elegant, sleek and ideal for a range of wrist sizes. The Element's unique case has dramatic curves flowing from lug to lug. It has a striking mix of brushed, polished and bead blasted finishes. For those who seamlessly transition from desk work to adventure in the elements, this watch is an ideal choice. With water resistance up to 20 ATM and impressive scratch resistant coating, the Temper Red stays securely on your wrist as you face the elements. Prices shown in local currency.
